raw: {"verdict": "pass", "reason": "The patch takes a per-master Postgres advisory transaction lock, then checks for overlapping confirmed bookings (start < new end, end > new start) before inserting. This serializes concurrent checkouts across app servers and ignores cancelled, completed and no-show bookings. The loser gets `slot_taken` instead of a 500, and other masters and re-bookings after cancellation are unaffected. I could not see the route's error mapping or any other booking-write paths such as reschedule, so I'm assuming `slot_taken` already maps to the 409."}
